method: Native 102 indexed main-entry rows; type-11 pointer is body-relative and resolves a 0x27/0x01 varuint array. Independently cross-check all 1,662 members against new_mod_property_data.main_entry_no.
interpretation_gate: This establishes mod-code family membership by native numeric key. It does not yet bind these keys to mod_entry_data effect rows, rarity, tier, or gameplay calculations.
